content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with [article_no] [product_name] controller and two [product_name] expansion modules ([article_no]). I need additional outputs, and I currently have a [product_name] expansion module ([article_no]). Will it operate correctly if I connect it to the controller?

No, that will not function properly. The expansion module with [article_no] is not compatible with the [version_no] series controllers. For the [version_no] series, only expansion modules with article numbers ending in '2' are suitable; those ending in '0' or '1' will not work. Please reference the compatibility release from [company_name] for further details: Delivery Release for [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no] [IMAGE]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarification on which expansion modules are compatible with a specific [product_name] PLC series. The core issue identified is the lack of clear information about matching article numbers for expansion modules, particularly noting that only those ending in '2' are suitable for the [version_no] series. Unclear compatibility guidelines may result in users selecting the wrong modules and experiencing installation issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all available [product_name] expansion modules to operate with their chosen controller, or they would like more transparent, easily accessible compatibility guidance.
